headline: The investor's favor is fickle. Anthropic below issue price, Nvidia down
summary: Anthropic shares fell below their offer price five days after its stock market debut, while Nvidia also declined a day after Jensen Huang's unexpected return as chief executive.
why: Anthropic is a major AI developer, and Nvidia supplies the AI chips central to the sector's valuations, so moves in both affect AI-linked investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia shares declined the day after Jensen Huang's return as chief executive.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Analysts cited profit-taking after the debut, and Nvidia fell the day after Jensen Huang's unexpected return as chief executive.
